entries.excerpt: The trunk port carries VLAN 10 for the wired network and VLAN 20 for guests; management lives on VLAN 99.

entries.long_title: Recursive DNS resolvers on the home network
entries.excerpt: Two recursive resolvers answer on the LAN; upstream forwarding goes over TLS to the two nearest caches.

entries.long_title: Wireguard client configuration for the road laptop
entries.excerpt: The client config pins the endpoint to the home router's wireguard port and routes only the two internal subnets.

entries.long_title: DHCP lease hygiene and reservation bookkeeping
entries.excerpt: Reservations are recorded next to the MAC addresses; lease times drop to twelve hours so a re-addressed host cannot linger.

entries.long_title: Nginx TLS termination for the hosted services
entries.excerpt: Nginx terminates TLS at the edge and forwards to the backend over the loopback interface; certificates renew by DNS challenge.

entries.long_title: Nightly backup job schedule and retention
entries.excerpt: The backup job snapshots each service volume at two in the morning and prunes to thirty days of dailies.

entries.long_title: Log retention policy for the hosted services
entries.excerpt: Service logs rotate weekly and are kept ninety days; the archive tier holds a year of compressed monthly rolls.
